name: efactura-connection-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE efactura_connections(organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,environment TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_environment_valid CHECK(environment IN('test','prod')),status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_status_valid CHECK(status IN('disconnected','connected','needs_reconnect')),generation INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_generation_nonnegative CHECK(generation>=0),revision INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_revision_nonnegative CHECK(revision>=0),access_token_ciphertext TEXT,refresh_token_ciphertext TEXT,access_expires_at TEXT,refresh_expires_at TEXT,verified_cif TEXT CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_cif_digits CHECK(verified_cif ~ '^[0-9]{2,10}$'),connected_by TEXT,connected_at TEXT,updated_by TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_tokens_only_connected CHECK((status='connected')=(access_token_ciphertext IS NOT NULL) AND (access_token_ciphertext IS NULL)=(refresh_token_ciphertext IS NULL) AND (access_token_ciphertext IS NULL)=(access_expires_at IS NULL)),CONSTRAINT efactura_connections_identity_unless_disconnected CHECK((status='disconnected')=(verified_cif IS NULL) AND (verified_cif IS NULL)=(connected_by IS NULL) AND (verified_cif IS NULL)=(connected_at IS NULL) AND (verified_cif IS NULL)=(refresh_expires_at IS NULL)))

CREATE TABLE efactura_oauth_attempts(organization_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES efactura_connections(organization_id),nonce_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CONSTRAINT efactura_oauth_attempts_nonce_shape CHECK(length(nonce_sha256)=64 AND nonce_sha256 !~ '[^0-9a-f]'),generation INTEGER NOT NULL CONSTRAINT efactura_oauth_attempts_generation_nonnegative CHECK(generation>=0),consumed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,created_by TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,CONSTRAINT efactura_oauth_attempts_expiry_after_creation CHECK(expires_at>created_at))
